column1: #   path_substring  matched against the POSIX file path (a substring — use enough
#                   of the path to identify ONE file)
#   rule            ONE rule name to waive (e.g. screenshot-only-assert for an
#                   explicit visual-rendering test). Reserve * for a file wholly
#                   outside the lint contract — a visual test can still have a
#                   real pgrep/tmp/source bug, so do not blanket-waive it.
#   reason          why this finding is acceptable (shown in --strict output)
# Keep this list SHORT and justified; prefer fixing the scenario over waiving.
